title: BranchWeaver — AGI-style adaptive attack tree with dynamic fork/prune/weave

smart_rules: if >50% branches pruned in round then strongly favor pivot-mesh for new principals
if >=3 high-confidence horizontal branches then favor lateral-swarm to parallelize
if any branch reaches 'near_xxx' then force desire-chainer

pumapay_notes: Start with JWT/BOLA surface. Weave horizontal across users/merchants. Fork on callback and role surfaces. Prune pure vertical JWT forges quickly if failing.
